steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Evolution: The change in the inherited characteristics of a population over successive generations through the process of natural selection. This may result in the development of new species.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Describe the process of natural selection in five steps. | Explain how the development of antibiotic-resistant bacteria provides evidence for evolution. | State three causes of extinction and give an example for each.
